title: GANs · Mode Collapse · Wasserstein GAN with Gradient Penalty (WGAN-GP)
prompt: In **GANs**, what is **Mode Collapse** and why does the original minimax loss $\min_G \max_D V(D, G)$ suffer from vanishing gradients when the discriminator becomes too strong? How does **Wasserstein GAN with Gradient Penalty (WGAN-GP)** fix this using Earth Mover's Distance and 1-Lipschitz constraints?
